payload.title: every persona keeps only its residue
payload.body: Ruled, extending 'mav's cell restates its role' to every persona: kino and nico carry the architect role and add only their residue (archetype, domain, voice, mark); every restatement of the role's reads and routes is dropped, since a restatement drifts, as kino's already had. Realized in notebook-gaps by kino-residue and nico-residue.
